What's inside

Everything a signing tool needs, and the evidence.

A sealed PDF and a public record

A PAdES seal, a one-page certificate with a QR code and a SHA-256 audit chain. The QR opens the public record.

Guided signing on any phone

A one-time code, then Start, Next and Finish. In order or all at once, with reminders and an expiry date.

Templates and bulk send

Roles and fields kept in place, on one page, every page or a few. One envelope per CSV row, every row checked first.

API, webhooks and React

An HTTP API with OpenAPI 3.1 and Postman, signed webhooks, and a React signing view for your own app.

Aadhaar eSign through Leegality

The signer confirms with an Aadhaar OTP on Leegality's page. Pay only for completed eSigns. We never see the Aadhaar number.

Team roles and transfer

Owner, admins, members and viewers, plus a Billing admin. Hand a workspace to another account with its documents.

Free: 10 envelopes a month Cloud: ₹999 a month + GST Self-hosted: free, unlimited Apache-2.0 libraries AGPL-3.0 server and app
